facts.fact: A ministry of communications document seen by Bloomberg says Egypt intends to allocate up to USD 860 million a year from the general budget, from FY2026/27 to the end of 2030, for data centres, computing infrastructure, data security and AI use in state companies; the document gives no event date, so the story's published date is used.
facts.system: Data centres and computing infrastructure programme, general budget, FY2026/27-2030

note: Allocation is stated as an intention ('intends to allocate'); no prior-year figure, so no rose or fell.
